healthTips.title: Health Tips for Voice Care
healthTips.subtitle: Personalized recommendations based on your voice analysis history

welcome.title: Welcome to Voice Health Monitoring
welcome.tip1: Take your first voice analysis to get personalized health recommendations
welcome.tip2: Regular monitoring can help detect early signs of health changes
welcome.tip3: Voice patterns can reveal important insights about neurological health

medical.title: Medical Consultation Recommended
medical.tip1: Consult with a neurologist for comprehensive evaluation
medical.tip2: Keep a record of your symptoms and voice analysis results
medical.tip3: Early intervention can significantly improve treatment outcomes
medical.tip4: Consider getting a second opinion from a movement disorder specialist

movement.title: Movement & Exercise
movement.tip1: Regular aerobic exercise can help maintain motor function
movement.tip2: Practice balance exercises daily to prevent falls
movement.tip3: Consider joining a Parkinson's exercise program
movement.tip4: Stretching exercises can help maintain flexibility

monitoring.title: Regular Monitoring
monitoring.tip1: Great job maintaining regular voice analysis!
monitoring.tip2: Track trends in your voice patterns over time
monitoring.tip3: Share your analysis history with healthcare providers
monitoring.tip4: Consider weekly voice checks for optimal monitoring

voiceCare.title: Voice Care & Hygiene
voiceCare.tip1: Stay hydrated - drink 8-10 glasses of water daily
voiceCare.tip2: Avoid smoking and excessive alcohol consumption
voiceCare.tip3: Practice vocal exercises to maintain voice strength
voiceCare.tip4: Use a humidifier in dry environments
voiceCare.tip5: Avoid shouting or straining your voice

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle Recommendations
lifestyle.tip1: Maintain a regular sleep schedule (7-9 hours nightly)
lifestyle.tip2: Follow a Mediterranean diet rich in antioxidants
lifestyle.tip3: Manage stress through meditation or yoga
lifestyle.tip5: Limit caffeine intake, especially before voice analysis
